title: The classical universal clause updates the wrong variable name.
details: Handout8 Ch.10 Definition2.4 printed p.2: the clause for M |= ∀x φ[α] is printed using α[m/z], although the binder is x and z is not introduced. Replace z by x. With distinct x,z and φ=P(x), changing z leaves the value of x fixed and would misinterpret universal quantification. The varying-domain forcing clause on printed p.3 correctly uses x and is adopted with capture-free substitution. This is a local variable-name slip, not a defect in the model construction.
